wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 06-008 aggregates the view-border-rendering and screen-size-block entry points into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for the framebuffer presentation/composition pass. The read-only src/render/implement-view-border-rendering.ts and src/render/implement-screen-size-blocks.ts already implement vanilla R_DrawViewBorder / R_SetViewSize semantics; pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification. No cross-plan inventory rewrite was required (the two implement-* modules are not importer-counted in the renderer inventory).
